hero_kpi_rationale: Whirlpool's portfolio transformation, aimed at becoming a higher-growth and higher-margin company, is the primary driver of value creation for the enterprise.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales after deductions.
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales decreased due to deconsolidation of European operations.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline driven by strategic divestitures.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between net sales and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined slightly due to higher tariff costs, partially offset by efficiency gains.

kpis.name: Gross Margin (%)
kpis.explanation: Gross margin as a percentage of net sales.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin declined slightly, pressured by tariffs but supported by efficiency improvements.
kpis.signal: Gross margin stable but under pressure.

kpis.name: Net Earnings
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net earnings were $318 million, compared to a loss in the prior year, driven by gains and efficiency improvements.
kpis.signal: Return to profitability after prior-year loss.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Cash spent to acquire or improve physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures decreased compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 16.0 billion USD in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 7.19 billion USD in latest year

kpis.name: MDA North America Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Net sales for the Major Appliances North America segment.
kpis.description: Net sales in North America declined slightly in 2025, primarily driven by lower volume.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in sales from key market.

kpis.name: SDA Global Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Net sales for the Small Appliances Global segment.
kpis.description: The SDA Global segment achieved significant sales growth in 2025, driven by price/product mix.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in small appliances sales.

risks.title: Macroeconomic and uncertainty risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned at the beginning of section 1A, the language (challenging, adversely affect) indicates a major concern. Global economic uncertainty is a weighted macroeconomic factor.

risks.title: Financial markets access risks
risks.score_rationale: Credit rating downgrades in 2025 represent a recent and serious event (explicitly mentioned). Inability to access financial markets is qualified as a potential impact on financial condition and results.

risks.title: Inflation and pricing risks
risks.score_rationale: Inflation is presented as a direct risk affecting costs and the ability to adjust prices without impacting demand or gross margin. The language (beyond our ability to control) suggests potential difficulty.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data breach risks
risks.score_rationale: An entire paragraph is dedicated to cybersecurity, highlighting past and future vulnerabilities to cyberattacks. The language (materially adversely impact, loss of trust, reputational damage) indicates high severity.

risks.title: AI utilization risks
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned in the cybersecurity context, AI presents new risks. The language (unauthorized disclosure, infringement of intellectual property, new potential cyberattack methods) underscores potential dangers.

risks.title: IT systems and cloud failure risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the cybersecurity context but distinct from direct attacks. The language (failures, disruptions, breaches) indicates significant potential operational impact.

risks.title: Cost and supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs and supply chain costs are mentioned as negatively impacting gross margins. The report indicates tangible impact in 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: Whirlpool Corporation has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filing.
